'''Old Oglaw''' was a grizzled old [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who was stuck in [[Iritsa]] for several months while he worked through some contractual problems with a shipment.

He liked to talk to strangers and knew quite a bit about the local affairs of Iritsa. He was a staunch supporter of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
